issues.title: Coupon not applying to Advanced Course at checkout
Wrong company name in GST part of invoice

items.description: The coupon was assigned to the Advanced Course in the coupon's Products section, and the customer confirmed the discount now shows at checkout.
evidence: Ho gaya. Ab test karta hoon... haan, ab checkout pe discount dikh raha hai.

items.description: Support will check the wrong company name in the GST part of the invoice with the billing team and tell the customer by the next day.
evidence: main billing team se check karke aapko kal tak bata dunga.

items.description: Support explained that the customer can extend the coupon expiry date themselves in the coupon settings, where the date option is available.
evidence: Expiry aap khud coupon settings mein badha sakte ho, wahin date ka option milega.

items.description: Customer will extend the coupon expiry date that night.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call (Hinglish) with clear outcomes.
